canonical_data: a hosted store of versioned, provenance-tracked markdown articles behind OzBrain's own API and web app, shared by connected agents and human teammates
strengths: Staged writes with explicit promotion and role-based permissions (viewer/commenter/editor) prevent agents from silently overwriting a team's shared knowledge
Provenance and freshness are tracked per article, and the entire brain can be exported as plain markdown at any time
MCP-based connectors reach Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and other MCP-compatible clients without any local install
weaknesses: Single-founder, fully proprietary SaaS with no self-hosting option and no independent GitHub or adoption evidence to corroborate its claims
Retrieval is documented as keyword search over a routing index; no vector or semantic search is described
Data residency and compliance detail is thin: Supabase/Vercel hosting regions are only described as 'configured,' and no SOC 2 or similar certification is published
why_it_matters: A small, clearly specified reference for a shared, human-and-agent-editable knowledge base with an explicit staging and promotion workflow, distinct from personal-only PKM tools and from silent auto-capture memory services.
